name: the re-stamp comes 2 s after the row is read
why: Not a defect: a loaded machine, made deterministic. The tag findings are stamped by _queueFindingsRestamp() 150 ms after a row is read; the 1966 test read the stamp once, right after, and failed under parallel load (2026-11-16 NB-3641, 2026-11-17 petri, on main too). It now polls (a2bcf54b), so it must pass with the stamp 2 s late; its old form fails here with the same error as in the full runs. The 1968 test is not affected: the row whose stamp it checks is read early, and the last row expects no stamp.
